senses.gloss: m. (דחי) suspension, removal of a consecrated object from its purpose; disability.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 7b:2">Kidd. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 12a:10">Zeb. 12ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>די מעיקרא חוי ד׳</he> a primary disability (existing at the time of the vow) is considered like a removal (through a cause of a later date), (opp. to <he>נראה ונדחה</he>, v. <cite ref="D00397"><he>דָּחָה</he></cite> Nif.).

<cite ref="Zevachim 12a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>יש ד׳ בדמים</he> the law concerning suspension or removal applies also to such objects as are consecrated only for the value they represent; a. e.—Pl. <he>דִּיחוּיִין</he>, <he>דִּח׳</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 63b:8">Yoma 63ᵇ</cite> <he>דלית ליה ד׳</he> who rejects the opinion concerning unfitness (of the scape-goat on account of an accident to the sacrificial goat).
